thread:
zoe: Quick Q from a manager: they collected anonymous peer feedback for a promo but one peer wants the feedback redacted before it goes to comp committee. Are managers allowed to edit or scrub peer comments?

marc: policy note: peer feedback must be submitted verbatim into the evidence folder. Managers should not edit content. If a peer requests redaction for legal/privacy reasons, escalate to People Ops.

ellen: operationally, what's the right workflow if a peer asks to redact a name but keep the comment content? we often use pseudonymized excerpts in packages.

carla_comp: for committee review we accept pseudonymized excerpts but the raw source must be preserved in People Ops records for audit. So manager can include a redacted excerpt in the packet but must attach the original feedback doc to the confidential evidence folder with restricted access.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Promotion Evidence Retention policy v1.4 requires unedited source feedback to be retained for 7 years in the secure People Ops drive. See: https://redwoodintra/confluence/promotions/evidence-retention

zoe: ok. How should managers label the redacted excerpt vs raw doc in Drive to avoid confusion?

carla_comp: naming convention we use: "candidate_lastname_peer-feedback_excerpt" and "candidate_lastname_peer-feedback_raw_internal". Put the excerpt in the public evidence folder and raw file in /Private/PromoAudit/2026. Also add a short note in the packet: "Raw feedback retained per retention policy; excerpt shared for committee review."

marc: small legal caveat: if the peer cited specific conduct or potential PII, escalate immediately to HR investigations before promo proceeds. Don't include potentially accusatory content in promotional packets.

ellen: thanks. One more practical item: comp committee wants a two-line "context" summary for each peer comment to speed review. Should managers craft that or should People Ops synthesize?

carla_comp: managers should add one-line context bullets under each excerpt (who the peer is relative to candidate: "teammate/sparring partner/lead"), not the peer's identity. People Ops can further synthesize for committee notes.

zoe: perfect. Could someone give a 3-bullet checklist managers can follow when preparing peer feedback for promos? I'll drop in the manager guidance doc.

carla_comp: checklist (paste):
- Preserve raw feedback: upload original verbatim file to /Private/PromoAudit and mark as "raw".
- Create pseudonymized excerpts: copy 1-3 relevant quotes into the public evidence packet with one-line context (role relation).
- If peer requests redaction or raises legal/PII concerns, stop and escalate to People Ops immediately before submitting the packet.

people-ops-bot: Action created: /task create "Add peer feedback checklist to manager promo guidance" assigned to zoe, due 2026-03-05.

zoe: I'll add this to Confluence and ping legal for a short blurb about PII redaction. Closing thread, thanks! :thumbsup:
